content.short: Lit is a decentralized key management network powered by threshold cryptography.
content.description: Lit is a decentralized key management network based on threshold cryptography. It enables reading and writing data across blockchains and off-chain platforms, supporting encryption, access control, and automation through programmatic signing. By aiming to decentralize public key cryptography, Lit allows apps with private data to use identity-based encryption and helps onboarding for non-crypto natives with MPC wallets. Comprehensive developer documentation is available to assist integration.
